title: Menu overhaul, new look and The Serpent
changes: New main menu: ARENA title, icon header (profile, friends, patch notes, watch live, suggestions) and a lobby party roster showing class, spec, side and ready state.
Drag skills in the Skill bar order strip to rearrange your bar; each slot shows its key and the match uses your order.
Hold Alt over a skill for an in-depth tooltip: how damage is built, what boosts it and diminishing returns. Rebind it in Controls.
Suggestions and Watch live now require signing in. Drop a .txt file on the suggestion box for longer ideas.
Twice the cosmetics: new unlockable looks earned by matches played, plus owner-only items.
HUD editor works from the main menu with a grid, snapping and many more frame and bar looks.
Sound revamp: every ability has its own cast, impact and ambient voices, plus footsteps per arena, low-health heartbeat and landings.
New arena The Serpent: two interlocking walls form an S-shaped corridor. Bots navigate around walls.

title: Patch notes
changes: New Patch notes list in the main menu showing every recent patch.

title: Pyroblast, mana and smarter retreats
changes: Pyroblast now hits for 550.
A fully cast Pyroblast always grants Hot Streak (the free instant one does not chain into another).
Mana regeneration: mage 12 → 24 per second, priest 6 → 15.
Bots look ahead for walls when backing away or running to cover and slide along them instead of getting stuck.
Bot mages Blink toward open ground, never into a wall, and cast Hot Streak Pyroblast first.

title: Play again and bot fixes
changes: Play again against bots always picks a different map and a different enemy class.
Bots no longer spin in circles: fixed the mage Blink-turn loop, rogue circling, tight melee strafing and ramp-foot wobble.
Bots respect diminishing returns and existing crowd control, hold burst for targets without defensives, and only interrupt casts that matter.
Bot brains retrained.

title: Bots that care for their lives
changes: Bots use defensive spells, shields and escapes earlier, step out of Flamestrike and Blizzard, and keep their own shield up.
Bots learn from how close matches were, not only from wins and losses.
Play again against bots picks a random enemy class.

title: Twin Ramps with a tunnel
changes: Twin Ramps rebuilt: a raised bridge deck with a ramp at each end and a walkable tunnel underneath, with line-of-sight rules for each level.
Specs no longer carry stat bonuses, so damage is flat for testing.
Casting needs the target within a 180° cone; Dragon's Breath is a 90° cone.
Walking backwards is 75% speed.
Pyromancy gets Cauterize: dropping to lethal damage leaves you at 35% health (3 minute cooldown).

title: Twin Ramps duel map
changes: New Twin Ramps duel map with a chasm, two ramps and a bridge. Duels are played there.
Rage gained from damage taken is halved.

title: Rage and tooltips
changes: Mortal Strike spends rage instead of generating it, and spenders no longer refund rage.
Tooltips say exactly what a spell deals.
The match countdown is 5 seconds.

title: Exact damage
changes: Damage has no random variance: every hit does exactly what the tooltip says.
No Blink while disoriented by Dragon's Breath.
Ground spells that cannot land are not cast, so no wasted cooldown.

title: Ground spells feel better
changes: Flamestrike can be cast in any direction, and the aim dot is coloured by line of sight.
Ground spells cast on mouse down instead of release.

title: Priest and mage fixes
changes: Devouring Plague's first hit no longer breaks fear.
Ice Barrier absorbs 40% of max health.
Dragon's Breath disorients and cannot be escaped with Blink.

title: Frost tweaks
changes: Frost Nova grants Fingers of Frost.
Ice Lance has a 1 second cooldown.
Mind Blast hits for 340.

title: Talent rows and random duel map
changes: New talent row pattern, plus frost, priest and warrior changes.
Suggestions can carry notes.
Duels use a random map.

title: Menu tidy
changes: Suggestions can be deleted and the menu corner is tidier.

title: Suggestions to Discord
changes: Suggestions are sent to a Discord webhook.
Kick and Pummel can miss.

title: Suggestion box
changes: New suggestion box in the menu.
Counterspell can whiff.

title: Barbarian and Arcane
changes: Barbarian: Reel In pulls enemies in a cone, Deep Cuts generates rage and Axe Throw is buffed.
Arcane Barrage deals +75% per Arcane Charge.

title: Rematch ready check
changes: Everyone readies up on the end screen to play again.
Bots learn from human replays.
Mage and warrior tweaks.

title: Hot Streak procs
changes: Fireball, Flamestrike and Dragon's Breath each have a 15% chance to grant Hot Streak.
End-of-match Play again and Leave buttons; shorter spec descriptions.

title: Cryomancy rework
changes: Cryomancy reworked around Fingers of Frost and Shatter.
Heroic Leap is a real jump.
You keep your party when leaving a match.

title: Warrior rework
changes: Warriors share Charge, Pummel, Hamstring and Heroic Leap.
New Warbringer, Rampager and Barbarian kits.

title: Party lobby
changes: The lobby shows every party member with a name tag and ready check.

title: Party looks
changes: Party members' models and skins show in the lobby.

title: Shadowstep and reconnect
changes: Shadowstep lands behind the target and turns your camera.
Reconnect after matches; unsynced settings are kept.

title: Rogue rework and learning bots
changes: Rogue rework.
Bots learn from the matches they play.
Louder party invites.

title: Warrior spec swaps
changes: Mortal Strike and Bloodthirst swap between warrior specs.
Bots play the spec they are given.
The end scoreboard closes when a new match starts.

title: Warrior weapons
changes: Warrior specs are weapons: dual wield, two-handed sword and polearm.

title: End scoreboard
changes: A scoreboard at the end of every match.
Warrior damage up about 30%.

title: Camera and shield bar
changes: Steadier camera under crowd control.
The shield bar is visible and white.

title: Spell queue and spectating
changes: The queue only repeats a spell in its last 0.25 s; conditional skills are blocked.
Owner live spectating and scoreboard.
